225-2645-3230-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3230-3430.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

765-3177-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7510.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Hancock
When Hancock dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hancock enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2921-6972-7510.notes: If Hancock starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

513-3821-5778.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
You control a nonland permanent that can be cast using at most three mana that lands you control can produce.
513-3821-5778.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning another nonland permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to untap up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast the nonland permanent returned to your hand in step 3 by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2034-2866-3836.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Urza.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Urza.
Repeat.

3817-4605-6797-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1805-3836-4331-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3490-3499-4289-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3499-4289-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2835-4050-5010-7028.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {B}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from your library.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
When the Spirit dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

4050-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

586-2292-5258-5618-6967.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

4826-5222-6644-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Sword of the Realms trigger.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that are untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{G}{G}{G}{W}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Realms by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ancient Adamantoise.
Repeat.

254-5641-6012.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 4.

4050-4681-4894-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

628-2034-6487.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Canker Abomination, adding {C}{C}.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, repeat from step 1.

1170-2196-2701-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2701-4477.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

1409-6348-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control a Dragon and/or have a Dragon card in hand.
1409-6348-6441.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2018-5231--73.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist or undying creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter or +1/+1 counter on it respectively, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Repeat.
2018-5231--73.notes: You must choose a persist or undying creature that does not have flying - otherwise the Luminous Broodmoth triggers do not occur.

891-2386-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Repeat.

643-1379-1558-3413.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other creatures.
643-1379-1558-3413.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Humans due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-4694-5175.notablePrerequisites:
"Green" chosen with Caged Sun.
Caged Sun does not have summoning sickness.
539-4694-5175.description:
Activate Caged Sun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Caged Sun triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat step 2.
As Caged Sun's triggered ability is a mana ability, this combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that cannot be interacted with, thus ending the game in a draw.

91-2335-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
91-2335-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Endling's third ability by paying {B}, giving Mairsil undying until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Mairsil dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1722-4050-4691-5213.notablePrerequisites:
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
You have a way to draw a card.
1722-4050-4691-5213.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Trespasser's Curse.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Trespasser's Curse trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1124-2793-4450-4659-5089.notablePrerequisites: {5} available on all odd-numbered extra turns, with {7} available on all even-numbered extra turns.
1124-2793-4450-4659-5089.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by exiling Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing any artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you to activate all planeswalker abilities an extra time this turn.
 Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by exiling Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

2011-2608.notablePrerequisites:
You control two additional creatures.
You control permanents that can produce at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Najeela, Derevi, and the additional creatures do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
2011-2608.description:
Attack with Najeela, Derevi, and at least two additional creatures.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When your creatures deal combat damage to a player, Derevi triggers at least five times, untapping at least five permanents you control.
Activate those permanents by tapping them to add at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures you control, giving them trample, lifelink, and haste, and creating an additional combat phase.
Repeat.
